news.title: Luminary Raises $22M to Expand Tech Platform for Wealth Transfer, Estate Management
Luminary raises $22M to bring AI to wealth transfer planning
Luminary Raises $22 Million to Power the Data Infrastructure Behind Wealth Transfer

bullets: Own the end-to-end experience for client intake, documents, and household data, including onboarding, AI-assisted review, and the core experiences for managing people, entities…
Build the shared platform for the Luminary Assistant, including common interaction patterns, context and data access, extensibility, and reusable AI capabilities.
Own integrations and developer capabilities, including first-class integrations, Luminary APIs, MCP, and other ways to move data into and out of Luminary.
Own enterprise product capabilities such as organizations, users and teams, permissions, access controls, auditability, and configuration.
Partner closely with Design and Engineering to turn complex systems into simple, intuitive product experiences.
